changes.title: Search from the top bar on eleven more pages [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The search button in the top bar spreads to release notes, notifications, support, extensions, logs, scenes, tags, the apps pages, sidebar labels and the integrations page, each losing the old field that used to scroll away with the content. At wide width the bar keeps to one row and the field is a fixed 360 px, the pattern builder opens holding the words already typed, and a reload with a search in the address shows the button as holding it.

Also: the newer zone editors get their small map, defender guard names and logged actions gain Cantonese, and "Custom" on the backup choice no longer does nothing when there is no Supervisor.

Seen in a browser for most pages at phone width. Not seen: stepping with Enter read back, the apps pages with a Supervisor, the zone map. The developer tools tabs and a handful of other pages still keep their own field.
changes.detail_yue:
頂欄個搜尋掣擴展到版本說明、通知、支援、擴充功能、記錄、場景、標籤、 應用程式頁、側欄標籤同整合頁，每頁都唔再要嗰個會跟住內容捲走嘅舊 搜尋欄。闊螢幕時頂欄保持一行，搜尋欄固定 360 px，打開樣式建立器會 帶埋已經打咗嘅字，重新載入時地址有搜尋字眼，個掣會顯示有嘢搜緊。

另外：新式區域編輯器有返細地圖，守護守則個名同記錄入面嘅動作有 廣東話，冇監督程式嗰陣撳備份選項嘅「自訂」唔會再冇反應。

大部分頁面喺手機闊度睇過。未睇：撳 Enter 逐個跳嘅位置、有監督程式 時嘅應用程式頁、區域地圖。開發者工具分頁同少量其他頁面仲用緊自己 嘅搜尋欄。

changes.title: Cameras: record live video around each event [skip ci]
changes.detail:
A camera that streams only through its service could not be recorded at all, which is a strange thing to say about a doorbell. The home now records about forty seconds of its live video each time something is seen. The sign-in never moves: the bundled streaming program is handed only the connection handshake, through a one-time address that works once, for thirty seconds, from this machine only. One live session per camera at a time, a budget of twelve clips an hour, and after the service says "too many requests" nothing asks again until the wait is over.

Proven end to end in a container against a pretend camera service: 10.3 seconds from event to a saved 10.00 second clip, the temporary stream removed afterwards, and no handshake text in the log. The clip the service already keeps is still copied in, and whichever arrives first wins; each row says where its clip came from.

Not yet proven on a real camera, and not yet seen in a browser.
changes.detail_yue:
只可以經供應商串流嘅鏡頭，以前係完全錄唔到，講緊嘅仲要係門鐘， 有啲講唔通。而家每次見到嘢，屋企會自己錄低大約四十秒直播。登入資料 原地不動：內置嘅串流程式只會收到連線握手，行一條用一次、三十秒內、 只限本機嘅一次性地址。每部鏡頭同一時間只開一個直播，每個鐘最多 十二段，供應商一話「太多要求」，等夠時間先會再問。

喺容器入面對住一個假嘅鏡頭服務由頭行到尾：事件到儲好一段 10.00 秒 嘅片用咗 10.3 秒，臨時串流事後有清走，記錄入面冇握手內容。供應商 本身留低嘅短片照樣會抄入嚟，邊個先到用邊個，每行都寫明條片邊度嚟。

未對住真鏡頭試過，亦未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Second browser look: courtesy wait obeyed, editor taps land [skip ci]
changes.detail:
More things that only show up when you actually use the thing. The sister's courtesy wait slider was ignored whenever her mode guard was on: the guard turned the heating off after its own short pause, so "ten minutes" meant "about half a minute". The courtesy wait is now the only wait, and zero means at once (seen: off within two seconds).

In the automation editor a tap on the first field of the bottom sheet did nothing, because the sheet's drag handle was quietly covering it. The automation list called every new-style trigger "Unknown trigger". A power threshold defaulted to milliwatts. The top bar search opened without focus, so typing "language" started the voice assistant instead of searching. An offline camera now says when it was last seen. A long update name ends before its button, not under it.

One test was failing on slow starts because it did not wait for a background retry; it waits now, and nothing in it was loosened.
changes.detail_yue:
第二次開瀏覽器睇，又睇到啲唔用就唔知嘅嘢。阿妹個「禮貌等候」滑桿， 只要佢個模式守則開住就冇人理：守則自己等一陣就熄暖氣，所以「十分鐘」 其實係「大約半分鐘」。而家只等禮貌等候，零就即刻熄（親眼見：兩秒內）。

自動化編輯器底部面板第一個欄位撳極都冇反應，因為面板個拉手靜雞雞 遮住咗佢。自動化清單將所有新式觸發叫做「未知觸發」。功率門檻預設 單位係毫瓦。頂欄搜尋打開之後冇焦點，打「language」結果叫咗語音助理 出嚟。離線鏡頭而家會講上次幾點見到。更新個名太長會喺個掣前面收尾， 唔會鑽入個掣下面。

有個測試喺慢啟動嗰陣會唔合格，因為冇等背景重試；而家有等，測試本身 冇放鬆過。

changes.title: Camera events: Play only with a real clip, and no more silence [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The Play button on a camera event never checked for a file. It only asked whether the camera was being recorded at all, so a doorbell could list two events, offer Play on both, and then admit there was nothing to play. Each event now has its own record: saved, being saved, or not kept with the reason in one line. Play appears only when a file is really there.

Nothing used to be logged when a clip could not be saved. A failure is now logged once with a reason code, counted, and shown as the camera's last problem, without any of the service's own error text. A first saved clip would also have crashed on a missing key; fixed.

For a camera that streams only through its service, the clip the service already keeps is copied in through the integration that holds the sign-in. Recording live video around an event is not built yet. Tested with a pretend camera only.
changes.detail_yue:
鏡頭事件個播放掣以前根本冇睇過有冇檔案，淨係問部鏡頭有冇人錄緊， 所以門鐘可以列兩個事件、兩個都畀你撳播放，撳完先認冇嘢播。而家每個 事件有自己嘅記錄：儲咗、儲緊、或者冇留低兼用一行字講原因。真係有 檔案先有播放掣。

以前儲唔到片係一聲唔出。而家會記低一次，寫明原因代碼，計數，仲會 顯示做鏡頭最近一次問題，唔會抄供應商啲錯誤原文。第一段片儲好嗰下 本來會因為少咗個鍵而出事，都修好咗。

只可以經供應商串流嘅鏡頭，會經揸住登入嗰個整合，將供應商本身留低 嘅短片抄入嚟。事件前後錄直播暫時未做。只用假鏡頭測試過。

changes.title: Design: camera events board, Play only with a real clip [skip ci]
changes.detail: A doorbell listed two events, each with a proud Play button, and nothing behind either of them: like a menu that lists the dish and then tells you the kitchen is closed. The board sets the rule: Play appears only when a clip is on disk, a missing clip says why in one line, and a camera that streams only through its service is recorded around each event by the home itself.
changes.detail_yue: 設計：鏡頭事件畫板，有真片先有播放掣。門鐘列咗兩個事件，個個都有個 好威嘅播放掣，但係後面乜都冇，好似餐牌寫住有呢碟餸，落單先話廚房 收咗工。畫板定咗規矩：片真係儲咗先有播放掣，冇片就用一行字講原因， 只可以經供應商串流嘅鏡頭，由屋企自己喺每次事件前後錄低。

changes.title: Search from the top bar, and a findable per-app backup choice [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The search field used to sit at the top of the content, which on a long page is somewhere back in last week. A search button now lives in the top bar, the one thing that never scrolls away. On Personal settings it opens in the bar, leaves the page where it is, marks the matches and steps between them. On list pages at wide width it filters in place with a count.

On the Updates page the "Custom" backup choice was a disabled button, so the per-app choice hid behind it like a staff-only door. Custom now opens the list, and a plain row says "Apps: choose which apps get a backup first".

Written and unit-tested only; not yet seen in a browser. Other pages that draw their own search field still have it in the content.
changes.detail_yue:
搜尋欄以前擺喺內容最頂，頁面一長，就好似擺咗喺上個禮拜咁遠。而家 搜尋掣搬上頂欄，成頁得嗰度唔會捲走。喺個人設定，搜尋會喺頂欄打開， 頁面留喺原位，標出搵到嘅地方，仲可以逐個跳。闊螢幕嘅清單頁就原地 篩選，有數顯示。

更新頁入面「自訂」備份選項原本係個撳唔到嘅掣，逐個應用程式揀備份 嘅設定就好似匿喺「閒人免進」門後面。而家「自訂」撳得，仲多咗一行 明明白白寫住「應用程式：揀邊啲更新前先備份」。

只係寫咗同做咗單元測試，未喺瀏覽器睇過。其他自己畫搜尋欄嘅頁面， 搜尋欄暫時仲喺內容入面。

changes.title: Design: canvas 40, search from the top bar [skip ci]
changes.detail: A board for a search button that lives in the top bar, because the bar is the one thing on a long page that never scrolls away. Tap it and the title turns into the search field; the page stays where it is and jumps to the match, instead of sending you back to the top like a snakes and ladders board.
changes.detail_yue: 設計：第 40 塊畫板，由頂欄搜尋。搜尋掣搬上頂欄，因為成頁咁長，得 頂欄唔會捲走。一撳，標題就變成搜尋欄，頁面留喺原位再跳去搵到嘅 地方，唔使好似玩蛇梯棋咁畀人送返去最頂。

changes.title: Fixes from the first look at batch two in a browser [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Looking at the work instead of trusting the tests paid off at once. The script sheet's Run button was a handsome blank rectangle with no word on it; the label is back. A sheet shrank the moment you left the Details tab, because the saved height was thrown away; it holds now. The camera recording page ignored the language mode entirely. A restored pause lost its reason code, so its line stayed in English. And a threshold trigger whose first unit choice is "none" now picks a real unit instead of sending the server nothing.

Disabled sheet buttons get a thin outline in the light theme: their fill was 1.24 to 1 against white.

Still unseen: saving triggers through the editor, the offline camera line, and most sheets in both-language mode.
changes.detail_yue:
真係開瀏覽器睇，好過淨係信測試，一睇就有收穫。腳本面板個「執行」掣 原來係一嚿靚仔但係冇字嘅長方形，而家有返字。一離開「詳情」分頁， 面板就縮水，因為記低咗嘅高度畀人掉咗，而家守得住。鏡頭錄影頁完全 唔理語言模式。還原返嚟嘅暫停冇咗原因代碼，嗰行字一直係英文。門檻 觸發如果第一個單位選項係「冇」，而家會揀返一個真單位，唔會乜都唔 交畀伺服器。

淺色主題入面停用咗嘅掣加咗條幼邊，因為佢哋嘅底色同白色對比得 1.24。

未睇過：喺編輯器儲存觸發、離線鏡頭嗰行、大部分面板嘅雙語模式。

changes.title: Defenders: guard descriptions, reasons in two languages [skip ci]
changes.detail:
Each of the 51 guards now says in one line what it actually does, which beats guessing from a name like a menu with no pictures. The reason line is worded by the page in English and Cantonese from a reason code, with tests that fail when a code has no wording. The sibling row gets an Open link, the sister's courtesy wait is a setting (0 to 30 minutes, default 10), setup waits for the climate entity to exist, and entities go unavailable with the unit.

A walk through a whole day with both of them on one unit found two real faults: she never switched a unit that was cooling over to heat below her floor, and the shared log announced that he had stopped when he was not even running. Both fixed. Retention of touches and commands now follows the reference program.

Written and tested without a browser; not yet seen on screen.
changes.detail_yue:
五十一條守則而家每條都有一句說明，講清楚自己做乜，好過睇住個名估， 好似冇圖嘅餐牌咁。原因嗰行由頁面按代碼出中英文，邊個代碼冇字句， 測試就唔過。兄妹嗰行多咗「開啟」連結，阿妹嘅禮貌等候變成設定（0 至 30 分鐘，預設 10），設定會等冷暖氣實體出現先開工，部機離線，實體都 跟住顯示離線。

兩個一齊睇住一部機行足一日，搵到兩個真問題：室溫跌穿阿妹條底線嗰陣， 部機開緊冷氣佢唔識轉去暖氣；阿哥根本冇開工，共用記錄就話佢停咗。 兩樣都修好。觸碰同指令嘅保留時間跟返參考程式。

未喺瀏覽器睇過，只係寫咗同測試咗。

changes.title: Updates card folds, real start times, camera lines, editors [skip ci]
changes.detail:
The automatic updates card stops taking most of a phone screen and rests as one summary row. A page opened in the middle of an update used to shrug and say the start was unknown for good; it now corrects itself once the job's real start arrives. The camera sheet says when an offline camera was last seen, and Light recording gets a picker for what counts as "something was seen".

In the automation editor the event type is a searchable picker, zone triggers and conditions show a small map, and a timer trigger that wrote its duration as text (which the server would refuse) now writes it properly. A new test reads the server's own trigger and condition descriptions and checks every editor against them.

Written and unit-tested only; not yet seen in a browser.
changes.detail_yue:
自動更新張卡唔再霸住手機大半個螢幕，平時收埋做一行摘要。喺更新中途 先開嘅頁面，以前會擺晒手話開始時間永遠唔知，而家收到真正開始時間就 會自己改返。鏡頭面板會講離線鏡頭上次幾點見到，輕量錄影多咗個揀選器， 可以揀邊啲嘢算係「見到嘢」。

自動化編輯器入面，事件類型變成可以搜尋嘅揀選器，區域觸發同條件會 顯示細地圖，計時器觸發之前將時間寫成文字（伺服器會拒收），而家寫返 啱格式。新測試會讀伺服器自己嘅觸發同條件說明，逐個編輯器對返。

只係寫咗同做咗單元測試，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Entity sheets: fit the content, compact switches, Cantonese [skip ci]
changes.detail:
On a phone a sheet is now as tall as what is in it, instead of renting the whole screen for a single switch. Switches, input booleans, sirens and plain fans get the compact 56 px switch, valve, cover and script buttons are properly visible in the light theme, and the sheets speak Cantonese for this project's own wording plus the tabs and headings. The coverage test now also guards the fifteen helper kinds; removing the zone mapping was watched turning it red.

Written and unit-tested only; not yet seen in a browser.
changes.detail_yue:
手機上面，面板而家有幾多內容就幾高，唔會為咗一個開關就租晒成個 螢幕。開關、輔助開關、警報器同普通風扇用返 56 px 嘅矮身開關，閥門、 窗簾同腳本嘅掣喺淺色主題終於睇得清楚，面板入面呢個項目自己嘅字句， 連埋分頁同標題，都識講廣東話。覆蓋測試而家連十五種輔助類型都睇埋， 試過拎走 zone 嗰行，測試真係會紅。

只係寫咗同做咗單元測試，未喺瀏覽器睇過。

changes.title: Docs: handoff, roadmap and feature pages up to the defenders [skip ci]
changes.detail: The paperwork catches up with two days of building. New feature categories for updates and for the two defenders, pages for the integration editors, drafts, backup progress and self-check, camera live sharing, entity sheets and the phone pass. The roadmap gains 39 items and is honest about them: 6 ticked, 8 partly, 25 still open, because "written" and "seen working" are not the same dish.
changes.detail_yue: 文件終於追返上兩日嘅工程。新增「更新」同「兩位守護」兩個功能分類， 仲有整合編輯器、草稿、備份進度同自我檢查、鏡頭直播共用、實體面板同 手機版面嘅說明。路線圖加咗 39 項，老老實實：6 項剔咗、8 項做咗一半、 25 項未完成，因為「寫咗」同「見到佢行得」唔係同一碟餸。
